description: Zero-trust security rollout: enforce mTLS everywhere, restrict egress, and deploy identity-aware proxy. Must: deploy internal CA (cert-manager), issue mTLS certs to all services, configure service mesh (Istio) with STRICT mTLS, deploy identity-aware proxy (Google IAP or AWS ALB with OIDC), configure egress firewall rules (default deny + allowlist), and verify all service-to-service traffic uses mTLS. Risk factors: mTLS breaking non-mesh services, egress denylist too strict breaking dependencies, cert rotation causing outages, identity-aware proxy adding latency. Tools available: Istio, cert-manager, terraform, kubectl, aws CLI.
